name: Hodiah
title: Jewish man, married to Naham's sister
summary: Hodiah is mentioned in Judah's genealogy. His wife was the sister of Naham, and through her the lineages of Ke'ila and Ma'aka are connected.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hodiah is listed in Judah's genealogy along with his wife, the sister of Naham.
